# Kareer

> Kareer is a desktop Chrome and Firefox extension that fills job application forms from a saved profile. Local autofill is free. Optional Kareer AI helps answer application questions and draft tailored résumés and cover letters.

## Product and setup

- [Kareer](https://kareer.itsamro.me/): Product overview, interactive demo, and frequently asked questions.
- [Install and use Kareer](https://kareer.itsamro.me/setup/): Official browser stores, profile setup, first run, and troubleshooting.
- [Application compatibility](https://kareer.itsamro.me/compatibility/): Tested workflows and limits for Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and generic forms.
- [Résumé and cover letter guide](https://kareer.itsamro.me/guides/tailor-resume-and-cover-letter/): Example of tailoring two documents from the same saved facts.

## Pricing and data handling

- [Kareer pricing](https://kareer.itsamro.me/pricing/): Free local tools, the AI trial, paid credits, and request costs.
- [Pricing in Markdown](https://kareer.itsamro.me/pricing.md): The same plan and credit-cost data in plain text.
- [Privacy policy](https://kareer.itsamro.me/privacy/): Local storage, AI requests, and provider handling.
- [Security](https://kareer.itsamro.me/security/): Credentials, payments, application controls, and vulnerability reporting.
